name: Spark Savings USDC
oneLiner: spUSDC is Spark's ERC-4626 V2 savings wrapper of USDC; share price compounds the Vault Savings Rate while exits redeem from vault USDC liquidity.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: spUSDC resolves to Upstream because the wrapper holds USDC as its only reserve, inheriting Circle's blacklist surface.

collateral: USDC deposited into Spark Savings Vault V2 (ERC-4626 asset=USDC); idle USDC is deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer. Spark documents V2 USD vaults as economically fully backed by USDS / Sky balance-sheet liquidity for redemptions.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to mint spUSDC; share price appreciates against USDC as the Vault Savings Rate (vsr) accrues while SLL deploys idle assets. Withdrawals burn spUSDC for USDC subject to vault idle liquidity or Savings Liquidity Intents for large exits.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Spark materials describe an ERC-4626 savings wrapper with USDC and Sky liquidity-layer exposure, but the complete current deployment-wide assurance, custody, valuation, reconciliation, and recovery semantics needed to resolve the mechanism archetype are not disclosed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spark Savings USDC is tracked on Ethereum and Avalanche as a wrapper/variant of USDC. On-chain reads on 2026-07-20 confirm both deployments are local Spark ERC-4626 savings vaults over local USDC (immutable clones, zero proxy admin), so issuance is native per chain with inherited USDC exposure.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-5 (lead usd1-world-liberty-financial)

routes.reviewNote: On-chain 2026-07-20: 163-byte minimal proxy (implementation 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455, EIP-1967 admin slot zero — no upgrade authority) of the Spark ERC-4626 savings vault with asset() = USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48; shares mint natively against local USDC deposits. The vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN is the Spark DAO SubProxy (SPARK_PROXY 0x3300f198988e4C9C63F75dF86De36421f06af8c4) per the Spark address registry. No bridge control carries the claim.

On-chain 2026-07-20: 163-byte minimal proxy (implementation 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12, EIP-1967 admin slot zero — no upgrade authority) of the Spark ERC-4626 savings vault with asset() = USDC 0xB97EF9Ef8734C71904D8002F8b6Bc66Dd9c48a6e; shares mint natively against local USDC deposits. The vault's DEFAULT_ADMIN is the Spark cross-chain governance executor (SPARK_EXECUTOR 0x7566DEbC906C17338524A414343fA61BcA26A843, driven from mainnet via the LZReceiver 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F) per the Spark address registry. No bridge control carries the claim.

mintAuthority.summary: spUSDC shares are minted against deposited USDC in the reviewed Spark ERC-4626 vaults, but the complete current Spark governance, wrapper-admin, and inherited USDC issuer control path is not reconciled. The profile remains unresolved.

controls.evidence: Local metadata marks spUSDC as `variantOf: usdc-circle` and `variantKind: savings-passthrough`; collateral text describes USDC deposits into Spark's ERC-4626 savings vault V2.

review.evidence: The cited Ethereum and Avalanche vault observations establish local ERC-4626 share issuance against deposited USDC and identify Spark-linked administrators. They do not resolve the conflicting proxy or clone characterization, the actual implementation upgrade capability on both deployments, or the ultimate authorization path through SPARK_PROXY, SPARK_EXECUTOR, and the cross-chain governance receiver. The inherited USDC issuer path is separately documented but not reconciled with every wrapper route.
unresolvedQuestions: Verify the active implementation model and mint-relevant upgrade capability for both 0x28b3a8fb vault deployments.
